title: Ollie's Duck Pack
description: Adds a couple duck themed changes to Minecraft.
body:
![Pack icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b15425649db01290aeca5b7d3a71304ef63746ba.png)Adds some duck themed changes to minecraft.
-------------------
This includes:

- Spawn egg
- eggs
- chicken variants
- water bucket
- xp bar
- hearts
- hotbar
- Item names
- And a lot more...
----------------------
